# SocialUs today: what you can do

**As of 2026-10-30** · Beta · Source: the criterion reports on socialus-web main and today's live smoke · Generated by: `write-launch-report`

- Open Explore and see what is going on near you this week, as a list or on a map, with one filter button.
- Sign in with just your email and a 6-digit code; then give your name, display name and zip, and the zip picks your area.
- If your town is not open yet, join its waiting list with only an email and watch the count grow.
- Start a Page for anything you do: a shop, a group, a class, a market stall, with one question asked and no legal or tax forms.
- Agree to four plain rules once before you publish; drafts save without them.
- Post an announcement with a time on it, and it shows under today or this week until it passes.
- Put one picture on a post and a picture on your Page; a Page with no picture still shows one.
- Follow a Page or a person and see them under Following; nothing else changes.
- Post a Wonder: say what you want to make together, set a target, and neighbours tap "I'm in" or offer to help in a role.
- Report anything you see; a second report hides it, the poster is told why, and a person reviews it.

Members see display names only; your legal name stays with the platform.
